rationale: Restore the direction-independent v0005 invariant (a citeable availability ref must be backed by an observed store_inventory row at the queried store) that v0006 collapsed into a lower-bound-only 'passes the availability test' rule. On 'less than / at most / fewer than N' availability questions the v0006..v0015 wording made the executor cite product_variants.record_path for SKUs with no store_inventory row (NULL from the LEFT JOIN), which the grader rejects with 'answer contains invalid reference /proc/catalog/<sku>.json' (t45 = 0% in 20260529-150148 and 20260529-151240; passes only on >=K phrasings). Citeability is now gated on an observed store_inventory row regardless of predicate direction; numeric count semantics unchanged. Analysis: .tasks/task-026/analyze_failes.md.

dependencies.why: Trusted date provider used when product count/update handling invokes policy_update_scan.
Actor identity pulled at session start (drives 'my' handling).
Public product facts, properties JSON, and the canonical catalogue record_path.
Per-SKU property rows (product_sku, property_key, property_value_*) used for claim verification.
Family/brand/model grouping used to identify products.
product_kind_id and product-kind scope for count questions.
Store/SKU availability source: available_today_quantity keyed by (store_id, product_sku).
Public store ids, record_path cite paths, city nuance targets, and open status.
Natural-language branch nuance used to choose between multiple stores in one city.

rollback.strategy: Revert to v0015 if gating refs on an observed store_inventory row drops a product ref the grader required on a non->=K availability question, or if non-pure / claim-verification refs regress.

retired_reason: post-world-refresh clean competition: prevent resolver fallback to stale historical BP versions while keeping version files in place for future PA-fix history
